LanguageData.LP_Lich.label: lich body
LanguageData.LP_Lich.description: An undead body sustained by psyfocus. The phylactery preserves the soul and original genes; needs no food, sleep or recreation, doesn't bleed, cannot heal naturally. Repairs and reshapes the body with psyfocus.
LanguageData.LP_Limb.label: soul reinforcement
LanguageData.LP_Limb.description: Each stack adds 20% to that part's max health and 12% part efficiency, taking up 5 points of max psyfocus. Only supports the head, torso, spine, arms, legs and major organs (brain, heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, stomach, eyes, ears); small parts like fingers can't be enhanced. At most 5 stacks per part; the enhancement disappears if the part is lost.
LanguageData.LP_Construct.label: necromantic construct
LanguageData.LP_Construct.description: A creation under a lich's command. Goes dormant when it loses its master or command capacity is insufficient.
